 Atp Finals, Fognini also at Cobolli’s training: “Need a sparring partner? I’ll give you a 6-2 6-2”
 ADNKRONOS 
 November 17, 2026
 Share via email Copy link Link copied
 (Adnkronos) – Head held high after the knockout. Flavio Cobolli returns to training on the court ahead of his second Atp Finals match against Frances Tiafoe. And during the eve’s training session, there’s no shortage of smiles and the usual lightheartedness on the fan village court, besieged by hundreds of curious onlookers queuing up to grab a selfie with the Italian. Flavio takes to the court shortly after 4 PM and exchanges shots for just over an hour with young Slovenian Ziga Sesko, number 3 in the ITF rankings. The warmth of the crowd is not lacking for him, as captured by a sign placed beyond the glass by a young fan: “Go all out, Flavio”. Postcards from Turin.
 In the final part of the training, his friend Fabio Fognini then appears courtside. Flavio calls him: “Fognini”. The former Italian champion replies with a joke: “Do I have to play too? If you need a sparring partner, tell me. I’ll give you a 6-2 6-2”. A gag that draws a smile from those present, during a session where Flavio insists on baseline shots and particularly on the diagonal backhand with his dad Stefano, his coach. “Against Medvedev, I really liked his mental approach, I had told him to be lighthearted and enjoy it,” explained today – in an interview with Adnkronos – the Italian’s father-coach. “I believe he did. Then he met a great opponent, difficult to beat in these court conditions and with his experience. Now, focus on the next one, there are still possibilities and he will give everything as always”. Exactly what fans expect on Wednesday evening.
